SELECT ROWNUM NO, -- 0 Y.BUYER_ITEM_NO, -- 1 Y.DESCRIPTION, -- 2 Y.PURCHASERNAME, -- 3 Y.ADD_DATE, -- 4 Y.ADD_TIME, Y.DS_QTY, -- 5 Y.PO_DATE, -- 6 Y.GR_DATE, -- 7 Y.REMARK, -- 8
Y.STATUS, -- 9
CASE WHEN Y.STATUS='PR' THEN '주문' ELSE CASE WHEN Y.STATUS='PO' THEN '발주' ELSE CASE WHEN Y.STATUS='DS' THEN '접수' ELSE CASE WHEN Y.STATUS='IV' THEN '납품' ELSE CASE WHEN Y.STATUS='GR' THEN '입고' END END END END END AS STATUS,
Y.DS_DATE, -- 10 Y.DELY_TO_LOCATION_TEXT, -- 11 Y.UNIT_MEASURE, -- 12 Y.RD_DATE, -- 13 Y.GR_QTY, -- 14 Y.REF_NO, -- 15
Y.BUYER, -- 16 Y.SEQ, -- 17 Y.DS_SEQ, -- 18 Y.DI_QTY, -- 19 Y.PACKAGE_STATUS -- 20 FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM NUM , X.BUYER_ITEM_NO, X.DESCRIPTION, X.PURCHASERNAME, X.ADD_DATE, X.ADD_TIME, X.DS_QTY, X.PO_DATE, X.GR_DATE, X.REMARK, X.STATUS, X.DS_DATE, X.DELY_TO_LOCATION_TEXT, X.UNIT_MEASURE, X.RD_DATE, X.GR_QTY, X.REF_NO,
X.BUYER, X.SEQ, X.DS_SEQ, X.DI_QTY, X.PACKAGE_STATUS
FROM ( SELECT A.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, (SELECT DESCRIPTION_LOC FROM ICOMBYIT WHERE BUYER=A.BYIT_COMORG_CODE AND BUYER_ITEM_NO=A.BUYER_ITEM_NO) AS DESCRIPTION, (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID=A.PURCHASER_ID) AS PURCHASERNAME, A.ADD_DATE AS ADD_DATE, A.ADD_TIME AS ADD_TIME, B.DS_QTY AS DS_QTY, A.PO_DATE AS PO_DATE, B.GR_DATE AS GR_DATE, B.BTOA_REMARK AS REMARK,
CASE WHEN A.PR_QTY ^=0 AND NVL(B.PO_QTY,0)=0 THEN 'PR' ELSE CASE WHEN A.PR_QTY ^=0 AND NVL(B.PO_QTY,0) ^=0 AND B.DS_QTY^=0 AND B.DS_DATE IS NULL THEN 'PO' ELSE CASE WHEN A.PR_QTY ^=0 AND NVL(B.PO_QTY,0) ^=0 AND B.DS_QTY^=0 AND B.DS_DATE IS NOT NULL AND B.INV_DATE IS NULL AND B.INV_USEr_ID IS NULL THEN 'DS' ELSE CASE WHEN A.PR_QTY ^=0 AND NVL(B.PO_QTY,0) ^=0 AND B.DS_QTY^=0 AND B.DS_DATE IS NOT NULL AND B.INV_DATE IS NOT NULL AND B.INV_USEr_ID IS NOT NULL AND B.GR_USER_ID IS NULL THEN 'IV' ELSE CASE WHEN A.PR_QTY ^=0 AND NVL(B.PO_QTY,0) ^=0 AND B.DS_QTY^=0 AND B.DS_DATE IS NOT NULL AND B.INV_DATE IS NOT NULL AND B.INV_USEr_ID IS NOT NULL AND B.GR_USER_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'GR' END END END END END AS STATUS,
TO_CHAR(B.DS_DATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS DS_DATE, A.DELY_TO_LOCATION_TEXT, (SELECT UNIT_MEASURE FROM ICOMBYIT WHERE BUYER=A.BYIT_COMORG_CODE AND BUYER_ITEM_NO=A.BUYER_ITEM_NO) AS UNIT_MEASURE, B.RD_DATE AS RD_DATE, B.GR_QTY AS GR_QTY, A.REF_NO AS REF_NO,
B.BUYER AS BUYER, B.SEQ AS SEQ, B.DS_SEQ AS DS_SEQ, B.DI_QTY AS DI_QTY,
CASE WHEN C.RECV_FLAG='GB' THEN '반려' ELSE CASE WHEN C.RECV_FLAG='FY' THEN '취소' ELSE CASE WHEN C.RECV_FLAG='NW' THEN '등록중' ELSE CASE WHEN C.RECV_FLAG='ED' THEN '완료' ELSE CASE WHEN C.RECV_FLAG='IG' AND C.MM_STATUS='ED' AND C.DD_STATUS ^='ED' THEN '마케팅' ELSE CASE WHEN C.RECV_FLAG='IG' AND C.MM_STATUS='ED' AND C.DD_STATUS='ED' AND C.EE_STATUS ^='ED' THEN '문안' ELSE CASE WHEN C.RECV_FLAG='IG' AND C.MM_STATUS='ED' AND C.DD_STATUS='ED' AND C.EE_STATUS='ED' AND (C.ES_MK1_STATUS='N' OR C.ES_PD1_STATUS='N' AND C.ES_QA1_STATUS ='N')THEN '디자인' ELSE CASE WHEN C.RECV_FLAG='IG' AND C.MM_STATUS='ED' AND C.DD_STATUS='ED' AND C.EE_STATUS='ED' AND C.ES_MK1_STATUS='Y' AND C.ES_PD1_STATUS='Y' AND C.ES_QA1_STATUS='Y' THEN '최종확인' END END END END END END END END AS PACKAGE_STATUS
FROM DB_OFF_PO A, DB_OFF_IV B, DONGOPKG C WHERE 1=1
AND A.BUYER = #{st_buyer_code}
AND A.BUYER IN ('KRDONG0110','KRDONG0107','KRDONG0128')
AND A.ADD_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date}
AND A.PO_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date}
AND B.RD_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date}
AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO LIKE '%' || #{st_buyer_item_no} || '%'
AND (SELECT DESCRIPTION_LOC FROM ICOMBYIT WHERE BUYER=A.BYIT_COMORG_CODE AND BUYER_ITEM_NO=A.BUYER_ITEM_NO) LIKE '%' || #{st_description} || '%'
AND (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID=A.PURCHASER_ID) LIKE '%' || #{st_purchaser_name} || '%'
AND CASE WHEN A.PR_QTY ^=0 AND NVL(B.PO_QTY,0)=0 THEN 'PR' ELSE CASE WHEN A.PR_QTY ^=0 AND NVL(B.PO_QTY,0) ^=0 AND B.DS_QTY^=0 AND B.DS_DATE IS NULL THEN 'PO' ELSE CASE WHEN A.PR_QTY ^=0 AND NVL(B.PO_QTY,0) ^=0 AND B.DS_QTY^=0 AND B.DS_DATE IS NOT NULL AND B.INV_DATE IS NULL AND B.INV_USEr_ID IS NULL THEN 'DS' ELSE CASE WHEN A.PR_QTY ^=0 AND NVL(B.PO_QTY,0) ^=0 AND B.DS_QTY^=0 AND B.DS_DATE IS NOT NULL AND B.INV_DATE IS NOT NULL AND B.INV_USEr_ID IS NOT NULL AND B.GR_USER_ID IS NULL THEN 'IV' ELSE CASE WHEN A.PR_QTY ^=0 AND NVL(B.PO_QTY,0) ^=0 AND B.DS_QTY^=0 AND B.DS_DATE IS NOT NULL AND B.INV_DATE IS NOT NULL AND B.INV_USEr_ID IS NOT NULL AND B.GR_USER_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'GR' END END END END END = #{st_po_status}
AND CASE WHEN A.PR_QTY ^=0 AND NVL(B.PO_QTY,0)=0 THEN 'PR' ELSE CASE WHEN A.PR_QTY ^=0 AND NVL(B.PO_QTY,0) ^=0 AND B.DS_QTY^=0 AND B.DS_DATE IS NULL THEN 'PO' ELSE CASE WHEN A.PR_QTY ^=0 AND NVL(B.PO_QTY,0) ^=0 AND B.DS_QTY^=0 AND B.DS_DATE IS NOT NULL AND B.INV_DATE IS NULL AND B.INV_USEr_ID IS NULL THEN 'DS' ELSE CASE WHEN A.PR_QTY ^=0 AND NVL(B.PO_QTY,0) ^=0 AND B.DS_QTY^=0 AND B.DS_DATE IS NOT NULL AND B.INV_DATE IS NOT NULL AND B.INV_USEr_ID IS NOT NULL AND B.GR_USER_ID IS NULL THEN 'IV' ELSE CASE WHEN A.PR_QTY ^=0 AND NVL(B.PO_QTY,0) ^=0 AND B.DS_QTY^=0 AND B.DS_DATE IS NOT NULL AND B.INV_DATE IS NOT NULL AND B.INV_USEr_ID IS NOT NULL AND B.GR_USER_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'GR' END END END END END IN ('PR','PO','DS','IV')
AND A.STATUS ^='D' AND A.BUYER=B.BUYER AND A.ADD_DATE=B.ADD_DATE AND A.SEQ=B.SEQ AND B.STATUS ^='D' AND B.CLOSE_FLAG||NVL(B.GR_QTY,0) ^='Y0' AND C.BYCA_COMORG_CODE(+)=A.BYIT_COMORG_CODE AND C.RD_DATE(+)=A.OPKG_RD_DATE AND C.OPKG_SEQ(+)=A.OPKG_SEQ AND C.BUYER_ITEM_NO(+)=A.BUYER_ITEM_NO ) X ) Y ORDER BY Y.ADD_DATE, Y.ADD_TIME, Y.PO_DATE DESC, Y.BUYER_ITEM_NO
